narratives.Overview:
## Recut of the filed body

Handwritten ingest from the bound successor-lean Bound-remedy. Not issue:ingest. #4258: Recut harvest still maps plan.items and stated acceptance from the GitHub body; extractPlanItems cannot see a Bound-remedy numbered list. Body PATCH as the ingest path is the #4254 trap and is rejected on #4258. Do not restamp design-critique:mechanism-shaped.

Bound by successor lean 5591348099, verified-claims table 5591394437, and synthesis 5591397893 (dispatch SHA 37c306e8c223d0eb5231acc400ac4a07b64b4521). That arc accepted all four classified headings. The filed matcher-split-as-root repair is withdrawn.

## Problem

On Grok Build TUI, implement-class spawn_subagent into a dest-proven linked worktree does not start. Grok merges Cursor and Claude hook files by default. Directive deposits one SPAWN_HOOK_MATCHER including spawn_subagent onto those files. Cursor occupancy and rewrite then run against Grok spawn_subagent. Cursor updated_input is a PreToolUse envelope; Grok applies it as tool args and schema-fails missing field prompt.

Round-1 critic 5591333464: matcher-split-as-root does not isolate, because Grok aliases Task to spawn_subagent on the shared deposit file. Isolation is inside the handler.

## Field instance

Grok Build TUI, deftai/directive, 2026-09-08, origin/master 37c306e8, @deftai/directive@0.113.0. Native spawn_subagent with cwd to a dest-proven worktree: Hook denied, updatedInput failed the tool schema, missing field prompt. Same fail re-measured when dispatching this arc critic.

## What to build

The next-build contract is the Bound-remedy of lean 5591348099 (plan.items below). Not the filed Product repair numbered list.

## Rejected

- Matcher-split-as-root (literal spawn_subagent removed from Cursor/Claude matchers) as the isolation
- issue:ingest of the GitHub body (#4258 harvest hole)
- GitHub body PATCH as the ingest path (#4254 trap)
- [compat.cursor] hooks = false as the product fix
- Teaching Grok isolation=worktree
- Folding #4219 CLI grok --cwd classification

## Related

- #4241 (closed) plan skip is grok-host-only
- #4219 (open) CLI classification; do not fold
- #4254 (closed) dest-lock after first allow; leftover lock is in scope here
- #3987 (closed) matcher cousin

narratives.UserStory: As a Grok Build orchestrator, I want dest-proven cwd-only spawn_subagent to start a child under default Cursor/Claude hook compat, so that through-merge workers dispatch without an envelope rewrite dropping required prompt.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: In dispatcher and spawn occupancy, when GROK_SESSION_ID or GROK_HOOK_EVENT is present or the tool is spawn_subagent, apply the Grok dest contract and do not emit envelope updatedInput even if argv --host is cursor or claude. Persist dest-lock only after the applying host accepted the input, or clean leftover locks. Keep rewrite-shape as a backstop (tool-arg object with prompt and cwd). Tests at packages/core/src/hooks and spawn-occupancy. CHANGELOG [Unreleased]. Do not treat matcher token subtraction as the close.
